data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in order (Wikipedia, then Booking.com, then a note) with the right parameters, but it misses the "review score of 8 or more" selection rule, so "pick a hotel" and "the chosen hotel" are vague. It also omits the do-not-Reserve constraint, and it never names the Notes "New note" click or the Enter keypress. The note template uses {date} instead of {checkin}, and it limits the scope to French cities and one-night stays.
